entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 9041 of 2024

Applicant :- Smt Suman
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- J.B. Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Virendra Kumar Srivastava
Hon'ble Vivek Varma,J.
1.

The present Anticipatory Bail Application has been filed with the prayer to grant anticipatory bail to the applicant in Case Crime No. 24 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Sections 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station- Basauni, District- Agra.

2. After arguing the matter at some length, Sri J.B. Singh, counsel for the applicant prays for withdrawal of the present application with liberty to the applicant to surrender and apply for regular bail.
3. In view of the above, the instant application is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.
